title: Deus — Service
description: One deus service end to end: SLO, RED, latency, dependencies, outbox, database, saturation, logs and traces.

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, target, slo, deployment) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Deus.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"})

panels.title: Availability (30d)
panels.description: Share of this service's requests answered without a 5xx over the 30-day SLO window.

panels.title: Availability budget left
panels.description: Error budget of the availability SLO still unspent in the 30-day window: 100% none used, 0% the SLO is met exactly, below 0 it is violated.

panels.title: Latency SLI (30d)
panels.description: Share of requests faster than the service latency threshold.

panels.title: Latency budget left
panels.description: Error budget of the latency SLO (requests slower than the threshold) still unspent in the 30-day window.

panels.title: Burn rate 1h (worst SLI)
panels.description: How fast the worst SLI of this service spends its budget over the last hour: 1 spends it in exactly 30 days, 14.4 pages (2% of the budget in one hour).

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Requests this service answers per second (5-minute average).

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Requests per second by HTTP method and route pattern; /internal routes are calls from other services.

panels.title: Responses by status code
panels.description: 4xx are the caller's mistakes or business rules (validation, unknown document, closed period) and do not count against the SLO.

panels.title: 5xx ratio by route
panels.description: Share of each route's requests answered with a 5xx (server error).

targets.expr: (sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="deus", service_name="$service", http_route!~"/openapi.*", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="deus", service_name="$service", http_route!~"/openapi.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="deus", service_name="$service", http_route!~"/openapi.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Server-side response time of the whole service: median, 95th and 99th percentile.

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: 95th percentile response time per route: which endpoint is slow.

panels.title: Slower than the SLO threshold — by route
panels.description: Latency SLI per route: share of requests slower than the service threshold. The dashed line is the 1% the SLO allows; one slow route shows up here even when the service average looks fine.

targets.expr: clamp_min(1 - histogram_share(scalar(max(slo:sli_threshold:seconds{target="$service", slo="latency"})), sum by (http_route, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="deus", service_name="$service", http_route!~"/openapi.*"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Requests per latency bucket; a band moving up means the whole service slowed down, a second band means a slow subset of requests.

panels.title: Outgoing calls by peer and status
panels.description: Calls this service makes to the /internal endpoints of other services (empty for leaf services).

panels.title: Outgoing p95 latency by peer
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of this service's calls to other services: slowness that comes from a dependency.

panels.title: Incoming calls by caller
panels.description: Which services call this one, as seen by the callers. Browser traffic through the gateway is in Traffic and errors.

panels.title: Events by destination and outcome
panels.description: Events written with the business transaction and delivered by the relay: journals to the ledger, allocations, emails. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff; dead ones are not.

panels.title: Waiting and dead events
panels.description: pending: written but not delivered yet. dead: rejected by the receiver or out of attempts; the receiving service is missing these documents until someone acts (DeusOutboxDeadEvents).

panels.title: Delivery delay p95
panels.description: Time from the business transaction to the delivery: how late the ledger, the other document or the email sees the change.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: Connections of the service's pools by state (DB_MAX_CONNECTIONS per pod) and requests waiting for a free connection (right). Waiting requests mean the pool is too small or queries hold connections too long.

panels.title: Operations by type
panels.description: Statements and transaction commands per second as the service sends them.

panels.title: p95 duration by operation
panels.description: Client-side duration: network, lock waits and execution together. The slow statements themselves are in Deus — Traces (SQL statements).

panels.title: CPU per pod
panels.description: CPU used by the app container of each pod, against its request. Above the request the pod competes for CPU with its neighbours.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", namespace=~"(.+-)?deus", pod=~"$service-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", container="app"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory per pod
panels.description: Working set memory of the app container of each pod, against its limit: at the limit the container is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", namespace=~"(.+-)?deus", pod=~"$service-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", container="app"})

panels.title: JavaScript heap per pod
panels.description: Heap in use reported by each Bun process. A heap that only grows between deploys is a leak.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts in the previous 10 minutes (OOMKilled, failed liveness probe, crash).

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: Log records of this service per interval by level.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:="$service" | stats by (severity_text) count() logs

panels.title: Top WARN and ERROR messages
panels.description: The 10 most frequent WARN and ERROR messages of this service and their cause.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:="$service" severity_text:in(WARN, ERROR) | stats by (severity_text, _msg, exception.message) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 10

panels.title: WARN and ERROR logs — $service
panels.description: Expand a line and follow trace_id to open the trace.

panels.title: Slowest traces
panels.description: Traces through $service slower than the selected minimum duration.

panels.title: Traces with errors
panels.description: Traces through $service with a span marked as error.
